Microsoft.summary:
GPT-4 launched in March 2023 with 8,192 tokens.
An Nvidia research team says that's often overkill and expensive.
Today, GPT 5.6 Sol handles around one million tokens, about 120 times as much and enough for Tolstoy's "War and Peace."

Microsoft.title: GitHub - pierridotite/mobile-agent-testers: 20 AI testers on 20 different phones, in parallel, on GitHub's free runners: Claude Code agents on iOS Simulators and Android emulators that find broken flows, translation, layout and accessibility bugs
Microsoft.titleEn: GitHub - pierridotite/mobile-agent-testers: 20 AI testers on 20 different phones, in parallel, on GitHub's free runners: Claude Code agents on iOS Simulators and Android emulators that find broken flows, translation, layout and accessibility bugs
Microsoft.titleKo: GitHub - pierridotite/mobile-agent-testers: 20개의 서로 다른 전화기에서 동시에 20명의 AI 테스터가 GitHub의 무료 실행자에 있음 · 깨진 흐름, 번역, 레이아웃 및 접근성 버그를 찾는 iOS 시뮬레이터 및 Android 에뮬레이터의 Claude Code 에이전트
Microsoft.summary:
Model usage was $0.15 to $0.55 per agent in these runs , so about $5 for 20 phones.
LocalSend's 20 devices took 69 minutes, builds included, because the Free plan runs 5 macOS jobs at a time.
In one run , the 4 demo testers found 9 of them (2 to 7 minutes per agent, about 21 minutes for the whole run, builds included), plus real issues nobody planted (a button under the Android nav bar, no data kept after a relaunch).
summaryLinesEn: Model usage was $0.15 to $0.55 per agent in these runs , so about $5 for 20 phones.

In one run , the 4 demo testers found 9 of them (2 to 7 minutes per agent, about 21 minutes for the whole run, builds included), plus real issues nobody planted (a button under the Android nav bar, no data kept after a relaunch).
summaryLinesKo: 모델 사용량은 이 실행에서 에이전트당 $0.15~$0.55이므로 전화기 20대당 약 $5임
LocalSend의 20개 장치는 빌드를 포함하여 69분이 걸렸음 · 왜냐하면 무료 플랜은 한 번에 5개의 macOS 작업을 실행하기 때문임
한 번의 실행에서 4명의 데모 테스터는 그 중 9개(에이전트당 2~7분, 전체 실행에 약 21분, 빌드 포함)와 아무도 심지 않은 실제 문제(Android 탐색 모음 아래 버튼, 재실행 후 데이터가 유지되지 않음)를 발견함

NVIDIA.titleEn: One gigabyte of Wikipedia losslessly compressed to 105.39MB with self-learning AI transformer model — 'tufazip' needs two Nvidia B200 GPUs and about a week to compress or decompress
NVIDIA.titleKo: 자가 학습 AI 변환기 모델을 사용하여 105.39MB로 무손실 압축된 1GB의 Wikipedia - 'tufazip'에는 Nvidia B200 GPU 2개가 필요하며 압축하거나 압축을 푸는 데 약 일주일이 소요됨
NVIDIA.summary:
Its GPUs peaked at 43.37 GiB of VRAM between them, and total memory use, GPUs included, peaked at roughly 68,525 MiB during compression and 73,748 MiB during decompression.
Alibaba claims new Qwen Image 2.1 AI model beats Google Nano Banana 2.0 with minuscule 7B parameter model Homelabber’s second-gen Optane build uses two RTX 3090s to run 2.8-trillion-parameter Kimi AI model at 3.11 tokens per second Lawyer builds private AI server with eight used Nvidia V100 GPUs While this sounds more exciting than, say, WinRAR, it’s for research purposes and not a product, and that’s underlined by what you’d need to actually run it.
Currently, two Nvidia B200 GPUs — plus two Intel Xeon Platinum 8570 CPUs in the test machine — would need 631,548 seconds to compress and 645,748 seconds to decompress the 105.39MB version, or about 7.3 and 7.5 days, respectively, not counting the starter’s offline training.

NVIDIA.summary:
Nvidia's revenue more than doubled year over year to $115.8 billion, and interim CEO Colette Kress raised the fiscal 2028 growth forecast to 75% from 70%.
TCA's model assumes revenue grows about 9% next year and allows for a recovery to a 6% net margin, roughly the sector median.
TCA also expects Nvidia to use up its remaining buyback authorization of about $227 billion by the end of fiscal 2028, as management has said it will, which would shrink the share count.

Apple.summary:
Apple Intelligence received some sizable updates and improvements with iOS 27 , and all those new features take up an awfully large amount of space on your phone.
According to Apple , it requires up to 14GB on the iPhone Duo, iPhone Air and iPhone 17 Pro or later, and 8GB on all other compatible iPhone models.
For those with only 128GB of storage, that's over 12 percent of your space taken up by something you might not even want to use.

According to a job listing , Apple is hiring a senior engineer to lead the project as a rival to Muse, Dots, Duet, and Grok Bots.

Apple.titleEn: Foxconn's next chapter: Why Apple's iPhone maker is betting big on AI
Apple.titleKo: Foxconn의 다음 장 · Apple의 iPhone 제조업체가 AI에 큰 투자를 하는 이유
Apple.summary:
Hon Hai Technology Group, better known as Foxconn, is betting on AI infrastructure to drive its next phase of growth.
Chairman Young Liu tellsChristine Tan that AI infrastructure could account for more than 60% to 65% of the company's revenue within three to five years.
He discusses Foxconn's partnership with Nvidia, growing demand for AI servers and data centers, and why he sees no signs of AI overcapacity.

Google DeepMind.titleEn: Finding faster quantum algorithms with agents and formal verification
Google DeepMind.titleKo: 에이전트 및 공식 검증을 통해 더 빠른 양자 알고리즘 찾기
Google DeepMind.summary:
For Cytochrome P450, an enzyme that breaks down most human medicines and is important for drug design, they found a 2.5× improvement and lowered memory from 481 to 333 qubits, by replacing bulky memory lookups.
In a new paper , we used teams of Gemini 4 agents to improve well-known quantum algorithms, creating highly efficient quantum circuits.
Running these algorithms in scientific simulations would still demand more computational resources than the first error-corrected quantum computers are likely to provide, but these improvements are significant.

Google DeepMind.title: Introducing file slicing controls in the Gemini API
Google DeepMind.titleEn: Introducing file slicing controls in the Gemini API
Google DeepMind.titleKo: Gemini API에 파일 슬라이싱 컨트롤 소개
Google DeepMind.summary:
With server-side slicing, you do not have to flatten files to plain text or ingest entire files up front.
You can now pass PDFs, Office files (docs, slides, spreadsheets), audio, and video directly to the Gemini API and request only the pages, spreadsheet cells, media segments, and layers you need.
The Gemini API now features native file slicing controls, allowing developers to specify targeted pages, sheet ranges, and media segments for the model to load server-side.

We’re adding Google Wallet and Drive to Personal Intelligence, allowing Search to provide answers based on your spending, documents, and chats.
Starting to roll out today, you can opt in to securely connect Google Wallet to Personal Intelligence in AI Mode , with support for Drive and the Gemini app following in the coming weeks — bringing context from your spending, documents, and chats directly to Search.

Amazon.title: AWS is making AI agents more decisive and secure with its latest Strands updates - SiliconANGLE
Amazon.titleEn: AWS is making AI agents more decisive and secure with its latest Strands updates - SiliconANGLE
Amazon.titleKo: AWS는 최신 Strands 업데이트를 통해 AI 에이전트를 더욱 결단력 있고 안전하게 만들고 있습니다 - SiliconANGLE
Amazon.summary:
The open-weight models are built on Google LLC’s Gemma 4 architecture and they’re available in various sizes, ranging from a lightweight edge version to a beefy 31 billion-parameter variant for complex decision-making.
AWS introduced Strands Agents back in May 2025, and recently the project has emerged as the centerpiece of the company’s agentic development strategy.
Today, the cloud infrastructure giant unveiled a new family of open-weight “decision models” called Strands Decider v2, along with the debut of Box CLI, bringing native sandbox support for popular coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Kiro CLI.
summaryLinesEn: The open-weight models are built on Google LLC’s Gemma 4 architecture and they’re available in various sizes, ranging from a lightweight edge version to a beefy 31 billion-parameter variant for complex decision-making.
AWS introduced Strands Agents back in May 2025, and recently the project has emerged as the centerpiece of the company’s agentic development strategy.

Today, the cloud infrastructure giant unveiled a new family of open-weight “decision models” called Strands Decider v2, along with the debut of Box CLI, bringing native sandbox support for popular coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Kiro CLI.
summaryLinesKo: 개방형 모델은 Google LLC의 Gemma 4 아키텍처를 기반으로 구축되었으며 경량 엣지 버전부터 복잡한 의사 결정을 위한 강력한 310억 매개변수 변형까지 다양한 크기로 제공됨
AWS는 2025년 5월에 Strands Agents를 출시했으며 최근 이 프로젝트는 회사의 에이전트 개발 전략의 중심으로 떠올랐음
오늘 클라우드 인프라 거대 기업인 IBM은 Box CLI의 데뷔와 함께 Strands Decider v2라는 새로운 개방형 "의사 결정 모델" 제품군을 공개하여 Claude Code, Codex 및 Kiro CLI와 같은 인기 있는 코딩 에이전트에 대한 기본 샌드박스 지원을 제공함

Today, the cloud infrastructure giant unveiled a new family of open-weight “decision models” called Strands Decider v2, along with the debut of Box CLI, bringing native sandbox support for popular coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Kiro CLI.

summaryLines: 개방형 모델은 Google LLC의 Gemma 4 아키텍처를 기반으로 구축되었으며 경량 엣지 버전부터 복잡한 의사 결정을 위한 강력한 310억 매개변수 변형까지 다양한 크기로 제공됨

Alpöge’s solution, presented in Lean, has only been published on his website and has not yet been publicly accepted by the Clay Mathematics Institute, which administers the Millennium Prize and offers a $1 million bounty for each problem solved.

OpenAI.title: Combatting adversarial distillation
OpenAI.summary:
The average attack success rate fell from 54.0% against GPT‑6 Astra with its original safeguards to 0.2% against GPT‑6.2 Astra with its updated safeguards.
Our September disclosure described attacks that moved encrypted reasoning from one conversation into another and asked the model to reveal the reasoning in user-readable form.
Our objective is to constrain the volume and value of the data distillers are able to obtain, to increase the cost of distillation campaigns, and to shorten the time needed to respond to new attacks.

Databricks.titleEn: How partners use Genie's free tier on Azure Databricks | Databricks Blog

Databricks.summary:
Every Azure Databricks user gets $10 of free Genie usage a month, and Genie budgets let admins control any spend beyond it.
Genie is built to meet that bar: every user gets free monthly usage so everyone can benefit, and budget controls are ready for when usage ramps.
Some customers block consumption-based AI tools entirely, and others hold off on a trial because they worry about what happens to costs as usage grows.

Sierra AI.title: Series F (Building the digital front door)
Sierra AI.titleEn: Series F (Building the digital front door)
Sierra AI.summary:
We’re raising $1.75 billion at a valuation of $30 billion, led by Greenoaks and Lightspeed Venture Partners.
Artificial intelligence is turning the old adage that we overestimate the impact of technology in the short term and underestimate it in the long term on its head.
We founded Sierra in the belief that AI agents would become the digital front door for every company, deepening their relationships with customers and opening up new growth opportunities.

Sierra AI.title: Releasing Personal Agent Protocol 1.0
Sierra AI.summary:
Mercury puts personal agents to work on finances: People who use Mercury for business and personal banking can now ask their personal agent to check balances, review recent transactions, categorize spending, or keep budgets and receipts up to date.
Made it easier for companies to adopt the protocol in stages, starting with the basics and adding capabilities over time; Expanded a company’s ability to provide guidance and collect feedback from the personal agent; Introduced extensions, such as the commerce extension co-authored by Shopify, so industries can build on the core protocol without changing it.
Sierra and Shopify bring Poppy to millions of merchants Shopify powers businesses in more than 175 countries, and every Shopify store supports Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) by default.
summaryLinesEn: Mercury puts personal agents to work on finances: People who use Mercury for business and personal banking can now ask their personal agent to check balances, review recent transactions, categorize spending, or keep budgets and receipts up to date.

Made it easier for companies to adopt the protocol in stages, starting with the basics and adding capabilities over time; Expanded a company’s ability to provide guidance and collect feedback from the personal agent; Introduced extensions, such as the commerce extension co-authored by Shopify, so industries can build on the core protocol without changing it.
Sierra and Shopify bring Poppy to millions of merchants Shopify powers businesses in more than 175 countries, and every Shopify store supports Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) by default.
summaryLinesKo: Mercury는 개인 에이전트를 통해 재무 업무를 수행함 · 비즈니스 및 개인 금융 업무에 Mercury를 사용하는 사람들은 이제 개인 에이전트에게 잔액 확인, 최근 거래 검토, 지출 분류, 예산 및 영수증 최신 상태 유지 등을 요청할 수 있음
기업이 기본부터 시작하여 시간이 지남에 따라 기능을 추가하는 단계적으로 프로토콜을 채택하기가 더 쉬워졌음 · 개인 에이전트로부터 지침을 제공하고 피드백을 수집하는 회사의 능력을 확대함 · Shopify가 공동으로 작성한 상거래 확장과 같은 확장 기능을 도입하여 업계에서는 핵심 프로토콜을 변경하지 않고도 핵심 프로토콜을 기반으로 구축할 수 있음
Sierra와 Shopify는 수백만 명의 판매자에게 Poppy를 제공함 · Shopify는 175개 이상의 국가에서 비즈니스를 지원하며 모든 Shopify 매장은 기본적으로 UCP(Universal Commerce Protocol)를 지원함

Scale AI.summary:
Anthropic's Series F, which valued it at the $183 billion Guo referenced, was announced in September 2025.
"If you ever feel stupid, just know that I didn't invest in Anthropic at $183B because I wanted to continue supporting my ex's lifestyle," Guo wrote on X.
We do crazy things for love — in Lucy Guo's case, she says that includes passing on an Anthropic investment that could've netted a billion dollars.

OneTrust.titleKo: OneTrust의 2026년 가을 릴리스로 AI 가시성, 개인 정보 보호 및 제3자 위험 도구 확장 - SiliconANGLE
OneTrust.summary:
OneTrust has raised $1.13 billion to date, including $150 million in 2023 at a valuation of $4.5 billion.
Drawing on previous assessments and supplier documentation, the company’s expanded AI Document Scanning and Inventory Response Analysis features can now also answer questions about the business engagement tied to a third party.
Building on OneTrust CORIE , a shared intelligence layer for governing artificial intelligence agents introduced at the company’s TrustWeek conference in September, the release covers AI visibility, privacy, consent and third-party risk management.

Replit.summary:
Founded in 2016, the company has more than 60 million users worldwide, including users at 85% of the Fortune 500.
Replit & Co. launched with 45 creators, including Marina Mogilko, known as "Silicon Valley Girl"; April Little, named to the 2025 TIME100 Creators list; and Carly Taylor, engineering leader and founder of Rebel Data Science.
18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Replit , the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications without learning to code, today announced Replit & Co., a new B2B creator program that brings together business and technology creators to demonstrate how enterprises can build software and put agents to work with Replit.

Hugging Face.title: How to build and maintain an agentic evaluation
Hugging Face.titleEn: How to build and maintain an agentic evaluation
Hugging Face.summary:
The Hugging Face hub is the home for AI evaluation: we host around 3500 eval leaderboards and have seen about a 16X growth in eval datasets on the hub in the past year , to about 17000 datasets.
As models became capable of planning and using tools, agentic benchmarks such as SWE-bench and WebArena expanded the scope to resolving software issues and completing tasks on websites.
In recent months, we have also incorporated support for agentic abstractions that are relevant to evaluation.

Hugging Face.title: RoboTrack: Point tracking for real-world robotic manipulation
Hugging Face.titleEn: RoboTrack: Point tracking for real-world robotic manipulation
Hugging Face.titleKo: RoboTrack: 실제 로봇 조작을 위한 지점 추적
Hugging Face.summary:
BootsTAPNext, the strongest model on DAVIS, falls 3.7 AJ behind CoWTracker on RoboTrack-Bench and even trails the Kubric-only AllTracker (60.2 vs 61.4 AJ), despite its training on 15 million real videos.
Finally, we moved points from the robot’s fixed base and mounting platform onto the moving arm, which brings our third-person view in line with real video as well and raises the ablation score to 63.0 AJ, 1.5 points above the Kubric-only control.
Following the TAP-Vid annotation approach, annotators use motion estimates to help trace each point through a video.

And most of all, share a fully reusable recipe, so you can reproduce this on your own task, harness, model combinations.
Our earlier work ( multi-harness RL , harness adapters ) showed that RL on your own task distribution, inside your own harness, gives a more accurate and more efficient model.
If we freeze those weights and add a custom RL-trained LoRA adapter we can get 55% pass@1, with average token usage of 1.5K.

Hugging Face.title: Rumble-2-Flash: an open 0.5B speech model for 40+ languages
Hugging Face.titleEn: Rumble-2-Flash: an open 0.5B speech model for 40+ languages
Hugging Face.titleKo: Rumble-2-Flash: 40개 이상의 언어를 위한 개방형 0.5B 음성 모델
Hugging Face.summary:
On the Open ASR Leaderboard multilingual track, Rumble-2-Flash averages a 6.96% error rate across Chinese, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Hindi, Dutch and English.
Runs anywhere : native support in 🤗 Transformers and vLLM, no custom code Output control : numbers as digits or words, fillers, verbatim repeats, forced language Extremely fast : an hour of audio in about half a second, with over 7,000 RTFx on full batches Holds up on real phone calls : on par with NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe (30B) on a 302-hour call-centre benchmark audio accepts a local path, a URL, a NumPy array, or a list of these.
It's a 0.5B-parameter speech recognition model for 40+ languages that competes with models 3-60x its size.

Runs anywhere : native support in 🤗 Transformers and vLLM, no custom code Output control : numbers as digits or words, fillers, verbatim repeats, forced language Extremely fast : an hour of audio in about half a second, with over 7,000 RTFx on full batches Holds up on real phone calls : on par with NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe (30B) on a 302-hour call-centre benchmark audio accepts a local path, a URL, a NumPy array, or a list of these.
It's a 0.5B-parameter speech recognition model for 40+ languages that competes with models 3-60x its size.

Hugging Face.titleEn: 180B Parameters, 32GB of RAM: Pushing MoE Inference to the Limit with Transformers
Hugging Face.summary:
To try it, install Transformers from that PR: Then, moving from OLMoE to the real target, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: That repo holds the output of the project's conversion script : the dense weights, the experts quantized to 3 bits, and the n-gram table.
I ran all of them on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on one A10G (24 GB), with plenty of RAM, and Harry Mellor reran vLLM with better flags: Offloading only the experts doubles vLLM's speed, and FP8 helps on top (half the bytes per expert, more of the model on the GPU). vLLM's other offload backend, which copies groups of layers ahead of time, ran under 1 tok/s.
I had a dual boot with Ubuntu, but their games ended up taking most of the two terabytes of disk.

Hugging Face.title: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
Hugging Face.titleEn: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
Hugging Face.titleKo: 미세 조정 작업이 FLOP에서 말하는 것보다 오래 걸리는 이유
Hugging Face.summary:
So we took 272 real supervised fine-tuning (SFT) jobs from our production pool of NVIDIA H200 GPUs, about 7,382 GPU-hours in total, and compared analytical estimates against learned predictors.
A CatBoost regressor that only sees information available before dispatch reaches R² = 0.98, with a mean absolute error of 1.71 h and a median error of 0.51 h in 5-fold cross-validation.
The short version: the usual FLOP-based estimate explains little of what we observed (R² = 0.31, MAE 12.41 h).

For our 2025 report, Generative AI adoption in the enterprise, we surveyed a diverse group of 1,600 knowledge workers actively using AI in the workplace — including 800 C-suite executives and 800 employees across the US.
Despite clear benefits, enterprise leaders report division and power struggles from AI adoption While executives are highly optimistic about the future business impact of AI, 42% say the process of adopting generative AI is tearing their company apart.
Enterprises without a formal AI strategy report only 37% success in AI adoption, compared to 80% for those with a strategy.

Writer.summary:
Today, 75% of knowledge workers use GenAI at work, but only about a third of organizations have formal AI governance in place For CIOs, this creates a familiar and uncomfortable reality: AI enthusiasm is accelerating faster than enterprise readiness.
Our newly introduced agent supervision suite delivers the governance foundation the report calls for — providing centralized visibility into usage and cost, global guardrails for sensitive data, runtime permissions and approvals, and deep integrations with your existing observability and security platforms.
And they need a model where IT can maintain oversight even as business teams accelerate adoption.

DeepSeek.title: India Startup Sells DeepSeek Access While Pursuing Sovereign AI
DeepSeek.titleEn: India Startup Sells DeepSeek Access While Pursuing Sovereign AI
DeepSeek.titleKo: 인도 스타트업, 주권 AI 추구하면서 DeepSeek Access 판매
DeepSeek.summary:
Indian startup Sarvam has begun selling access to DeepSeek and other Chinese AI models, triggering an online backlash over its role as one of the main proponents of the country’s AI independence.
Its catalog includes Sarvam’s own model, but also open-weight systems from Chinese AI labs DeepSeek, Moonshot AI and Z.AI Co.
This week, Sarvam unveiled Token Factory, an inference platform offering multiple AI models via a single API interface, hosted on local computing infrastructure.

Meta AI.titleEn: Instagram's new tool for creators targets unauthorized reposts and AI-modified videos
Meta AI.titleKo: 크리에이터를 위한 Instagram의 새로운 도구는 승인되지 않은 재게시물과 AI 수정 동영상을 표적으로 삼음
Meta AI.summary:
Instagram is introducing a new tool to help creators protect their original videos, the Meta-owned company announced Tuesday.
Instagram says the content protection tool continuously scans Instagram for unauthorized uses of creators’ protected videos.
The tool will also begin detecting AI-generated videos that reuse audio from creators’ original content, even when the visuals have been altered.

Instagram says the content protection tool continuously scans Instagram for unauthorized uses of creators’ protected videos.
